title: Scholarship for Children of Priests and Temple Employees
organization: Transport & Muzrai Department, Government of Karnataka
description: This scholarship scheme is designed for the children of Category 'C' temple priests and temple employees in Karnataka. It provides financial support to help these students access higher education opportunities.

title: First Graduate Scholarship Scheme
description: This state government initiative provides tuition fee concessions to underprivileged students who are the first graduates in their families. It aims to encourage first-generation learners to pursue higher education.

title: Bennett University and PRIF Scholarship Program for Women in STEAM
description: This specialized scholarship program targets female students aiming to pursue higher education in STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) fields. It provides financial assistance to promote gender diversity in technical disciplines.

title: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
description: This financial aid scheme supports the children of farmers in Karnataka, enabling them to complete their higher education. It is designed to alleviate the financial burden on rural and agricultural families.

title: Alagappa University Admission
description: Applications are invited for admissions to various undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional courses. Eligible students from all backgrounds can apply through the university's official registration portal.

title: CUSAT Admission 2026-27
organization: Cochin University of Science and Technology
description: Admissions are open for multiple undergraduate and postgraduate programs under the 2026-27 academic cycle. Selection is primarily based on the CUSAT Common Admission Test (CAT) eligibility criteria.

title: Osmania University Admission 2026
description: This admission drive covers diverse undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma programs at Osmania University for 2026. Prospective students must meet specific merit or entrance-based criteria to secure their seats.

title: CUSAT Admission 2026-27 (CAT 2026)
organization: Cochin University of Science and Technology
description: Admission opportunity for various undergraduate and postgraduate programs through the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026. Eligible candidates can apply for professional courses in engineering, science, law, and other streams.

title: MZM Varsity Scholarship Program
organization: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
description: This scholarship supports deserving students enrolled in the 5-year integrated BA LLB (Hons.) program at NLSIU, Bengaluru. Offered in partnership with the MZM Care Foundation, the scholarship covers the annual tuition and facilities fees.

title: NLSIU MZM Varsity Scholarship Program
organization: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
description: NLSIU has introduced the MZM Varsity Scholarship Program to support deserving law students. The scholarship aims to provide financial aid to students pursuing legal education.

title: Scholarship Program for Women in STEAM Education
description: This program offers scholarships to women pursuing education in STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) fields. It aims to encourage and support female representation in these disciplines.

title: Best Available Schools (BAS) Scheme
description: This scheme provides financial support to marginalized students, particularly from SC and ST categories, to access education at select private schools. It offers financial assistance of up to Rs. 20,000 for day-scholars and Rs. 42,000 for hostel-resident students.

title: Alagappa University Admission 2026
description: Alagappa University is offering admissions for various undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Eligible candidates can apply to secure admissions in diverse academic disciplines.
